title: Understanding Regularization
text: When you increase the regularization coefficient, you're essentially adding a penalty to the model's complexity. Think about how this might affect the model's ability to fit the training data closely.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Consider how adding a penalty for complexity might influence the model's variance. Does it make the model more or less sensitive to fluctuations in the training data?

title: Regularization and Model Complexity
text: As the regularization coefficient increases, what happens to the model's complexity?
choices: The model's complexity remains the same.

hintAnswer: The model is less likely to overfit.
title: Regularization and Overfitting
text: How does increasing the regularization coefficient affect the model's tendency to overfit?
choices: The model is more likely to overfit.
The model is less likely to overfit.
The model's tendency to overfit remains unchanged.
